title: Cross-Domain Relationship Schema
description: A directional relationship between entities in different business architecture domains, flowing from an initiating (source) domain to a receiving (target) domain. Active domains (strategy, capability, valueStream, initiative, policy, stakeholder) typically initiate relationships; passive domains (information, performance, product, service) receive them and never act as the source.

sourceDomain.description: The domain that initiates or provides in the relationship. Passive domains (information, performance, product, service) cannot be the source.

sourceEntityID.description: ID of the source entity, when the relationship is between specific records

targetDomain.description: The domain that receives the relationship

targetEntityID.description: ID of the target entity, when the relationship is between specific records

description.description: How the source and target interact

relationshipType.description: How the source entity relates to the target entity. Categories: financial: funds, measures, reports, forecasts; operational: depends, constrains, enables, mitigates, consumes, delivers, optimizes, maintains; governance: monitors, governs, audits, certifies, escalates, accountableFor, responsibleFor; informationAndKnowledge: informs, validates, enriches, learns, teaches, benchmarks; innovationAndTransformation: innovates, evolves, transforms, designs, implements; coordinationAndIntegration: orchestrates, integrates, synchronizes, aligns, prioritizes; marketAndDemand: drives, responds.

oneOf.description: (financial) Finance provides financial resources to another domain entity to enable its development, operation or enhancement
(financial) Finance expresses the activities, outputs or outcomes of another domain entity in measurable financial terms
(financial) Finance produces formal reports on the financial performance, costs or returns of another domain entity
(financial) Finance projects future financial needs, costs or revenues of another domain entity
(operational) The source receives necessary resources, services or capabilities from the target to deliver its outputs or outcomes
(operational) The source imposes limitations, standards or compliance requirements on the target's design, operation or evolution
(operational) The source is essential to the implementation, operationalization or fulfilment of the target
(operational) The source actively reduces the risks or vulnerabilities of the target
(operational) The source uses, relies on or draws from the resources, outputs or services of the target
(operational) The source provides specific value or outcomes to the target
(operational) The source improves the performance or efficiency of the target
(operational) The source ensures the ongoing operation of the target
(governance) The source oversees, measures or evaluates the performance or effectiveness of the target
(governance) The source defines policies, standards or decision rights that control the target's operation
(governance) The source formally examines the target for compliance, performance or quality
(governance) The source provides formal approval or certification to the target
(governance) The source receives escalated issues or exceptions from the target
(governance) The source is accountable for oversight of the target
(governance) The source has a clear line of responsibility for the target
(informationAndKnowledge) The source provides information or data that shapes decisions in the target
(informationAndKnowledge) The source confirms or verifies outputs, decisions or processes of the target
(informationAndKnowledge) The source enhances the data quality, completeness or value of the target
(informationAndKnowledge) The source gains knowledge or insights from the target
(informationAndKnowledge) The source transfers knowledge or capabilities to the target
(informationAndKnowledge) The source uses the target as a performance standard or reference point
(innovationAndTransformation) The source drives innovation or new developments in the target
(innovationAndTransformation) The source causes evolutionary change in the target
(innovationAndTransformation) The source drives transformational change in the target
(innovationAndTransformation) The source shapes the structure, approach or architecture of the target
(innovationAndTransformation) The source executes or realizes the vision, strategy or design of the target
(coordinationAndIntegration) The source coordinates the activities of the target alongside other entities
(coordinationAndIntegration) The source brings together outputs or processes from the target
(coordinationAndIntegration) The source ensures timing alignment with the target
(coordinationAndIntegration) The source is intentionally harmonized with the target in purpose, direction or design, without a direct dependency
(coordinationAndIntegration) The source influences the priority or sequencing of the target
(marketAndDemand) The source generates, influences or amplifies demand for the target's outputs, services or capabilities
(marketAndDemand) The source is triggered, adapted or activated in response to changes in the target or an external event

relationshipMetadata.description: Priority, impact area, frequency and strength of the relationship

anyOf.description: Long-term strategic importance; prioritize in strategic planning

impactArea.description: Area of the organization the relationship affects

frequency.description: How often the relationship is exercised

strength.description: Strength of the relationship: 1 very weak, 3 moderate, 5 very strong with critical dependency

conditions.description: Conditions under which the relationship exists

reviewDate.description: Date the relationship should be reviewed

outgoingRelationship.description: A relationship from the record that contains it (the source) to an entity in another domain. Used in a domain's crossDomainRelationships list.

targetDomain.description: The domain that receives the relationship

targetEntityID.description: ID of the target entity, when the relationship is between specific records

description.description: How the source and target interact
